scope: Deterministic native source/embedded contracts and five predeclared tool paths; no autonomous inference, provider tokens/cache/billing or new Pi comparison.

capture_inspection.contract: Same six positions: four captured source results remain exact; two raw capture dumps become structural metadata with unchanged complete-original references. This deliberately changes the inspection view, not the original evidence.

current_wave_native_prefix.control: Historical en-build3 and current embedded candidate share the same source cwd/current visible catalogue fingerprint. Mandatory AGENTS.md remains 10389 bytes. This is initial serialization only.

task_control: Classic13 versus lean10 within the new implementation, same real AGENTS.md and behavioral oracles. Native tools execute predeclared plans, not model inference or a complete native agent-loop benchmark. All ten outcomes passed in both source and embedded modes. Private path/identifier serialization contributes a few bytes; retained evidence includes every initial/peak/input/tool-result snapshot.
grouping_tradeoff: Two capture reads still execute, and singles already share one response. Grouping saves one wrapper invocation and 75 serialized input bytes but emits 76 more result bytes: input-plus-new-result sum is one byte worse. No demonstrated total-cost or model-round win; typed preflight and one wrapper are the evaluation result, not JavaScript codemode parity.
remember_tradeoff: Nine-tool pilot deferred remember and added discovery/worsened complete task input. Final lean10 retains remember, recall and workspace immediately; capabilities, read_many and tool_result are discovered. Rollback: WASM_AGENT_BOOTSTRAP_MODE=classic; full envelope rollback remains.

limitations: An optional procedure/tool first use can add discovery; this small fixture cannot select a universal optimum or establish autonomous quality.

Typed singles are opt-in and groups mandatory; a conservative JSON Schema subset is supported, not arbitrary JSON Schema. Unsupported constraints, composite enum values, malformed/duplicate JSON and invalid UTF-8 refuse.
Pure-read groups are serial, not concurrent/transactional, and never admit mutations, bash, plugins or MCP/app effects.
Capture metadata is structural, not evidence replacement. Arbitrarily large selected exact views can still need original byte retrieval.
Captured cursor records have no TTL/quota. Caller/workspace/profile/owner and artifact-integrity fences remain.

Graph confirmed already-planned read-batch/MCP checks but added no patch; callback prepare was a name-collision lead and dynamic/top-level edges were incomplete. audit_assess returned no_active_audit_step, not a successful assessment receipt.
Candidate proof is not installation. Old admitted failed deployment must be narrowly retired by the supported external executor; unknown notifications stay unknown and no old request may replay.
Stale-cache causal root remains unproven. Preserve old canonical targets before a clean-source rebuild rather than reviving the withdrawn manifest-dir hypothesis.
